todos.description: Create the missing data/candidate_scores.json file with real computed scores (or remove the reference from scripts/predict_tc.py if the file is not needed).
Remove the misleading coverage badge from README.md (or fix the test suite to actually produce coverage data and point to a real badge).

Remove all fabricated or unverifiable references from candidate_materials.md (e.g., 'Zhang et al., Phys. Rev. B 100, 2019') and replace with real, verifiable sources (DOIs or arXiv links). Clearly mark all predicted room-temperature superconductors as unconfirmed.

Add a detailed experimental plan for the top 3 candidate materials (e.g., La3Ni2O7, H3S, and one more) to proposed_chemistry_physics.md, including synthesis conditions, characterization methods, and expected Tc verification steps.
Update theoretical_framework.md to include a section on bilayer nickelate La3Ni2O7 (Tc ~80 K at 14 GPa, Nature 2023), covering DFT+DMFT results and comparison to cuprates.
Update discovery_strategy.md to reference the existing scripts (scripts/predict_tc.py and scripts/generate_candidates.py) and describe how they are used in the screening pipeline.
Update literature_review.md with recent breakthroughs (e.g., La3Ni2O7, room-temperature superconductivity in hydrides under pressure, and any 2024-2025 developments).
